tools.name: retailcloudpos_list_products
tools.description: List your products with their variants, SKUs, prices, cost, inventory and published status (true when a buyer published the product to the storefront). Read-only. Uses GET /v2/products.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_list_orders
tools.description: List orders to fulfill, with UIID, customer shipping address, SKU, quantity, cost, order date and personalization. Shipped orders are left out unless include_shipped is true. Read-only. Uses GET /v2/orders.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_get_purchase_order
tools.description: Get the purchase order (PO) number that holds an order, by its UIID. RetailCloud issues POs each business day for the preceding period. Read-only. Uses GET /v2/po.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_create_products
tools.description: Create products, or update a product that is still in offered status (same call). Maximum 250 products per request. A product with errors is not created; the others still are. New products stay offered until the buyer publishes them. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms the exa

tools.name: retailcloudpos_add_variants
tools.description: Add variants to an existing product. Give the SKU of one existing variant of that product. A product can hold at most 100 variants. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms. Uses POST /v2/variants.

tools.name: retailcloudpos_update_inventory
tools.description: Update the quantity, suggested retail price or cost of variants, by your SKU. Set available to 0 to stop sales of a SKU. A cost increase removes the product from the site until the buyer approves it. Check open orders before you change inventory. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user con

tools.name: retailcloudpos_add_tracking
tools.description: Add the tracking number and carrier to orders and mark them shipped. Call it only after the order has shipped. Changes bind the vendor: call only after the user confirms. Uses POST /v2/orders/fulfill.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: retailcloudpos_get_purchase_order · Public sink: retailcloudpos_create_products, retailcloudpos_add_variants, retailcloudpos_add_tracking.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: retailcloudpos_get_purchase_order · Public sink: retailcloudpos_create_products, retailcloudpos_add_variants, retailcloudpos_add_tracking

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
